from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0095.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
r,g,b=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
# light gray cabinet: near-neutral bright, distinguish from wall (wall is warm 210,207,197)
m=(abs(r-g)<8)&(abs(g-b)<10)&(r>200)&(r<245)
ys,xs=np.where(m); print('cab bbox u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
for u in range(115,235,10):
    rr=np.where(m[:,u])[0]
    if len(rr): print('cab u',u,'vtop',rr.min(),'vbot',rr.max())
print('--- pot bottom-most pixel')
p=(r>140)&(r<215)&(g>50)&(g<115)&(b<85)
ys,xs=np.where(p); i=np.argmax(ys); print('pot lowest',xs[i],ys[i], 'ucenter',(xs.min()+xs.max())/2)
print('--- vase')
vm=(b>r+40)&(b>150); ys,xs=np.where(vm); i=np.argmax(ys); print('vase lowest',xs[i],ys[i],'ucenter',(xs.min()+xs.max())/2)
" 2>/dev/null
